title: ‘The Illegality of the Plan Was Obvious’

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日时事通讯 DealBook 的商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场舞台上采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，其中包括万斯、

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的实时对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用来观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望大家能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: For months, the
sentences.zh: 几个月来，

sentences.en: Congressional Committee investigating January 6th has been trying to make the case that Donald
sentences.zh: 调查1月6日事件的国会委员会一直在试图证明唐纳德·

sentences.en: Trump and his allies committed a crime.
sentences.zh: 特朗普及其盟友犯下了罪行。

sentences.en: Well, in a blunt ruling today, a federal judge says it is, quote, more likely than not that former President Donald Trump and a right-wing attorney John Eastman
sentences.zh: 好吧，在今天的一份措辞直率的裁决中，一名联邦法官表示，用他的话说，前总统唐纳德·特朗普和右翼律师约翰·伊斯特曼

sentences.en: committed crimes in an attempt to stop the certification of the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 在试图阻止2020年大选结果认证的过程中犯罪，“可以说是八九不离十”。

sentences.en: A federal judge just ruled that in all likelihood, they did.
sentences.zh: 一名联邦法官刚刚裁定，他们极有可能这么做了。

sentences.en: In the ruling, Judge David Carter wrote, if Dr. Eastman and President Trump's plan had worked, it would have permanently ended the peaceful
sentences.zh: 法官大卫·卡特在裁决中写道，如果伊斯特曼博士和特朗普总统的计划得逞，它将永久终结和平的

sentences.en: transition of power, undermining American democracy and the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 权力交接，破坏美国的民主和宪法。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Luke
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事卢克·

sentences.en: Broadwater, with the story of how the committee achieved that ruling.
sentences.zh: 布罗德沃特将为你讲述该委员会是如何取得这一裁决的。

sentences.en: It's Monday, April 4th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月4日，星期一。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I feel like one of the annoying things about working from home for this long is that we have this weird absence of people saying hello to each other on the show.
sentences.zh: 我觉得居家办公这么久以来，一件烦人的事就是节目里少了一种大家互相问好的奇怪氛围。

sentences.en: So I'm going to insist today that we start the show with me saying, hello, Luke.
sentences.zh: 所以我今天坚持要以我对卢克说“你好”来开始节目。

sentences.en: Hi, Michael.
sentences.zh: 嗨，迈克尔。

sentences.en: It's really nice to see you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: Well, thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: It's nice to see you through a computer screen as well.
sentences.zh: 透过电脑屏幕见到你也很高兴。

sentences.en: We go with what we've got.
sentences.zh: 有什么条件就用什么条件吧。

sentences.en: So, Luke, what context do you think we need to understand this major court case?
sentences.zh: 那么，卢克，你认为我们需要什么样的背景来理解这起重大的法庭案件？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, as you know, the January 6th committee appointed by the House has been conducting a sprawling and aggressive investigation into the events of January 6th,
sentences.zh: 嗯，如你所知，众议院任命的1月6日委员会一直在对1月6日的事件进行广泛而积极的调查，

sentences.en: but also the events that led up to it.
sentences.zh: 还有导致这一事件的种种事端。

sentences.en: As part of that investigation, they have interviewed more than
sentences.zh: 作为调查的一部分，他们已经采访了超过

sentences.en: 800 witnesses.
sentences.zh: 800名证人。

sentences.en: They have issued more than 100 subpoenas, and they've gotten a lot of cooperation.
sentences.zh: 他们发出了100多张传票，并且得到了很多配合。

sentences.en: A lot of powerful, important people have sat down with them for depositions.
sentences.zh: 许多有权势的重要人物都坐下来接受了他们的闭门质询。

sentences.en: But there have been some, about two dozen of Trump's allies, who have been fighting the subpoenas with lawsuits in federal court.
sentences.zh: 但也有大约两打特朗普的盟友，一直在联邦法院通过诉讼对抗这些传票。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: They don't want to show up.
sentences.zh: 他们不想露面。

sentences.en: They don't want to play ball.
sentences.zh: 他们不想合作。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: They don't want to give any documents.
sentences.zh: 他们不想提供任何文件。

sentences.en: They don't want to sit for depositions.
sentences.zh: 他们不想坐下来接受质询。

sentences.en: And one of them is the conservative lawyer, John Eastman.
sentences.zh: 其中一人就是保守派律师约翰·伊斯特曼。

sentences.en: Hello, America.
sentences.zh: 全美民众，你们好。

sentences.en: Sorry, I had to say that.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我不得不这么说。

sentences.en: Eastman is the lawyer who members of both parties have said wrote what they call the blueprint for a coup.
sentences.zh: 伊斯特曼就是那个被两党议员称为起草了“政变蓝图”的律师。

sentences.en: We know there was fraud, traditional fraud that occurred.
sentences.zh: 我们知道确实存在欺诈，发生了传统的欺诈。

sentences.en: We know that dead people voted.
sentences.zh: 我们知道死人投票了。

sentences.en: But we now know...
sentences.zh: 但我们现在知道……

sentences.en: There were two memos he authored that explored different scenarios for how Donald Trump could stay in power despite losing the election.
sentences.zh: 他撰写了两份备忘录，探讨了唐纳德·特朗普在输掉大选的情况下如何继续保持权力的不同设想。

sentences.en: And all we are demanding of Vice President Pence is this afternoon at one o'clock, he let the legislatures of the state look into this so we get to the bottom of it.
sentences.zh: 我们对副总统彭斯所有的要求只是，在今天下午一点钟，他让各州立法机构调查此事，以便我们水落石出。

sentences.en: And ultimately, it came down to Vice President Mike Pence being willing to exploit what Mr. Eastman saw as a loophole in the Electoral Count Act to throw out
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这取决于副总统迈克·彭斯是否愿意利用伊斯特曼先生眼中《选举计票法》的漏洞，抛弃

sentences.en: legitimate electoral votes for Joe Biden in favor of electors for President Trump from states he did not win.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登合法的选举人票，转而支持特朗普总统在那些他并未获胜的州里选出的选举人。

sentences.en: And anybody that is not willing to stand up to do it does not deserve to be in the office.
sentences.zh: 任何不愿意挺身而出这样做的人都不配居其位。

sentences.en: It is that simple.
sentences.zh: 就是这么简单。

sentences.en: Which, of course, makes Eastman a very logical person for the January 6th committee to want to
sentences.zh: 当然，这使得伊斯特曼成为1月6日委员会想要

sentences.en: get testimony and documents from because, as you've just said, he's at the center of this plan.
sentences.zh: 获取其证词和文件的极其合乎逻辑的人选，因为正如你刚才所说，他是这一计划的核心人物。

sentences.en: Actually, he's the author of it to try to block Joe Biden from becoming president.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他就是试图阻止乔·拜登成为总统的计划的始作俑者。

sentences.en: Yes, they view him as a central key witness.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们视他为核心关键证人。

sentences.en: And so the committee tries two avenues to try to get information from John Eastman.
sentences.zh: 因此，委员会尝试通过两种途径从约翰·伊斯特曼那里获取信息。

sentences.en: The first is they schedule a deposition to try to get an interview with him in person to learn more about these plans and his role in them.
sentences.zh: 首先是他们安排了一次质询，试图与他进行面对面的采访，以更多地了解这些计划他在其中扮演的角色。

sentences.en: And the second is through their subpoena, they demand documents related to his plans, to his conversations with Donald Trump, to any effort to overturn the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 其次是通过传票，他们要求获得与他的计划、他与唐纳德·特朗普的对话以及推翻2020年大选的任何努力相关的文档。

sentences.en: John Eastman does appear for his deposition, but he thwarts the committee at every turn.
sentences.zh: 约翰·伊斯特曼确实出席了质询，但在每一步都阻挠委员会。

sentences.en: He pleaded the Fifth Amendment, his right against self-incrimination, 146 times.
sentences.zh: 他援引宪法第五修正案（即享有抗拒自证其罪的权利）多达146次。

sentences.en: And he did it so often, he and his lawyer, that he just started saying fifth instead of, I plead the fifth.
sentences.zh: 他和他的律师频繁地这样做，以至于他不再说“我援引第五修正案”，而是直接开始说“第五”。

sentences.en: And so they get nothing from him in person.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们从他口中什么也没问出来。

sentences.en: So the committee needs to rely on the hard evidence of actual paper, actual digital files, actual documents.
sentences.zh: 所以委员会不得不依赖实体纸张、实体数字文件、实体文档这些铁证。

sentences.en: But there, John Eastman files a lawsuit to block turning over these records to the committee.
sentences.zh: 但就在这里，约翰·伊斯特曼提起诉讼，试图阻止将这些记录移交给委员会。

sentences.en: And his central argument for why he shouldn't have to do this is he says all his communications and all his planning around January
sentences.zh: 他认为自己不必这样做的核心论据是，他关于1月6日的所有

sentences.en: 6th is covered by attorney-client privilege.
sentences.zh: 沟通和所有筹划都受到律师与客户特权（保密特权）的保护。

sentences.en: Who's his client?
sentences.zh: 谁是他的客户？

sentences.en: He says Donald Trump's his client.
sentences.zh: 他说唐纳德·特朗普是他的客户。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: And he presents a letter that is unsigned in which Donald Trump supposedly is to retain him as his lawyer.
sentences.zh: 他出示了一封未签署的信件，其中唐纳德·特朗普本应聘用他为律师。

sentences.en: But the committee argues there's no proof that Donald Trump ever signed that letter or agreed to it.
sentences.zh: 但委员会辩称，没有证据表明唐纳德·特朗普签署过该信件或对此表示同意。

sentences.en: That said, Eastman continues to assert it.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，伊斯特曼仍然坚称如此。

sentences.en: And because he does so, the committee has to go to civil court over it, which you can imagine is pretty frustrating for the committee as they're trying to get these documents.
sentences.zh: 正因为如此，委员会不得不为此诉诸民事法院，你可以想象，当委员会试图获取这些文件时，这会是多么令人沮丧。

sentences.en: But it actually creates an unexpected opportunity for the committee, who has been working quietly for months compiling the case of Donald Trump's
sentences.zh: 但它实际上为委员会创造了一个意想不到的机遇。几个月来，委员会一直在默默工作，整理唐纳德·特朗普

sentences.en: criminality as it relates to January 6th.
sentences.zh: 涉嫌与1月6日有关的犯罪证据。

sentences.en: Wait, how does Eastman invoking attorney-client privilege create an opportunity for the committee?
sentences.zh: 等等，伊斯特曼援引律师与客户特权怎么会为委员会创造机会呢？

sentences.en: Explain that.
sentences.zh: 解释一下。

sentences.en: So one way you can pierce attorney-client privilege, if you're the committee, is to invoke part of the law that allows an exception to it called the crime-fraud exception.
sentences.zh: 如果你是委员会，打破律师与客户特权的一种方法是援引法律中允许豁免的一部分，称为“犯罪-欺诈例外”。

sentences.en: And what that means basically is criminals can't use their lawyers to carry out their crimes and say it's all protected because of attorney-client privilege.
sentences.zh: 这基本上意味着，罪犯不能利用他们的律师来实施犯罪，并声称这一切都受到律师与客户特权的保护。

sentences.en: And so if the committee can establish that what Eastman and Trump were doing amounted to a crime,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果委员会能够确定伊斯特曼和特朗普所做的事情构成了犯罪，

sentences.en: then the committee can get around this attorney-client privilege that Eastman is invoking.
sentences.zh: 那么委员会就可以绕过伊斯特曼正在援引的这种律师与客户特权。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: And so they take this opportunity to lay out in federal court the case they've been building for why January 6th and Donald Trump's role in it was a crime.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们借此机会在联邦法院阐述了他们一直在构建的案例，即为什么1月6日以及唐纳德·特朗普在其中的角色是一场犯罪。

sentences.en: Because if they can prove that Eastman and Trump committed a crime, then they can get these records that John Eastman has sued to block.
sentences.zh: 因为如果他们能证明伊斯特曼和特朗普犯了罪，他们就能获得约翰·伊斯特曼通过诉讼试图阻止获取的这些记录。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: So what crimes do they accuse Eastman and Trump of?
sentences.zh: 那么他们指控伊斯特曼和特朗普犯了什么罪？

sentences.en: They accused Eastman and Trump of two federal felonies.
sentences.zh: 他们指控伊斯特曼和特朗普犯有两项联邦重罪。

sentences.en: One is conspiring to defraud the United States, and the second is obstruction of an official proceeding of Congress.
sentences.zh: 一项是串谋诈骗美国政府，第二项是妨碍国会官方程序。

sentences.en: Two enormous charges.
sentences.zh: 两项极大的指控。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: It was a bombshell court filing.
sentences.zh: 这是一份具有震撼力的法庭文件。

sentences.en: And how in this filing does the January 6th committee try to prove that they committed those two crimes?
sentences.zh: 在这份文件中，1月6日委员会是如何试图证明他们犯下了这两项罪行的？

sentences.en: Well, I'll walk you through the evidence.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我来为你梳理一下证据。

sentences.en: Please do.
sentences.zh: 请讲。

sentences.en: The first charge that they look at is obstruction of Congress.
sentences.zh: 他们审视的第一项指控是妨碍国会。

sentences.en: And in particular, the evidence here centers on two meetings in the days before January 6th.
sentences.zh: 特别是，这里的证据集中在1月6日之前几天的两次会议上。

sentences.en: The first is on January 4th, in which Donald Trump and John Eastman have Mike Pence and his top lawyer and his chief of staff come into the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 第一次是在1月4日，唐纳德·特朗普和约翰·伊斯特曼让迈克·彭斯及其高级律师和幕僚长进入了椭圆形办公室。

sentences.en: And at that meeting, Eastman presents the plan to Pence for how he can reject the Biden electors chosen by the voters to keep Donald Trump in power.
sentences.zh: 在那次会议上，伊斯特曼向彭斯提出了一个计划，即他如何拒绝选民选出的拜登选举人，以让唐纳德·特朗普继续掌权。

sentences.en: Once it appears that Mike Pence is unconvinced to go along with this, there is then a second meeting the next day on January 5th in which Eastman goes directly to
sentences.zh: 一旦显得迈克·彭斯不为所动、不愿随波逐流，紧接着第二天（即1月5日）又召开了第二次会议，伊斯特曼直接去找了

sentences.en: Pence's top lawyer, Greg Jacob, and again tries to persuade him with arguments for why Mike Pence should go along with this plan.
sentences.zh: 彭斯的高级律师格雷格·雅各布，再次用论点试图说服他，为什么迈克·彭斯应该顺从这个计划。

sentences.en: On top of that, Trump himself then directly goes to Pence and pressures him using a vulgarity to insist that he needs to go along with the plan to keep Trump in power.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，特朗普本人随后直接找到彭斯并向他施压，用粗俗的言辞坚称他必须顺从这个让特朗普继续掌权的计划。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: They say this amounts to a clear effort to obstruct an official proceeding of Congress.
sentences.zh: 他们说这相当于企图公然妨碍国会官方程序。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: The official proceeding of Congress being the certification of Joe Biden's rightful victory.
sentences.zh: 国会的官方程序就是对乔·拜登的正当胜利进行认证。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And what evidence does the committee present for the charge of defrauding the United States?
sentences.zh: 关于诈骗美国的指控，委员会出示了什么证据？

sentences.en: Well, we can start with those conversations between John Eastman and Greg Jacob.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们可以从约翰·伊斯特曼和格雷格·雅各布之间的那些对话开始。

sentences.en: In those, according to Jacob's testimony before the committee,
sentences.zh: 根据雅各布在委员会前的证词，

sentences.en: Eastman acknowledges that what he's doing is illegal.
sentences.zh: 在这些对话中，伊斯特曼承认他正在做的事情是非法的。

sentences.en: He calls it a minor violation of federal law.
sentences.zh: 他称其为违反联邦法律的轻微行为。

sentences.en: And he acknowledges in one conversation that these actions would not stand up to judicial scrutiny.
sentences.zh: 他在一次对话中承认，这些行动经不起司法审查的推敲。

sentences.en: He admits that he would lose 9-0 before the Supreme Court if they went through with this plan.
sentences.zh: 他承认，如果他们执行这个计划，在最高法院将会以9比0败诉。

sentences.en: So that gets to his state of mind, that he knew what he was doing was not in compliance with the law, but he continued to press for it anyway.
sentences.zh: 因此，这触及了他的心态，即他知道自己在做的事情不符合法律，但他仍然坚持推进。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Thus, he may be committing fraud.
sentences.zh: 因此，他可能在犯罪。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: According to the committee.
sentences.zh: 根据委员会的说法。

sentences.en: The other main argument the committee stresses again and again through these filings is that
sentences.zh: 委员会通过这些文件一遍又一遍强调的另一个主要论点是，

sentences.en: Donald Trump himself also knew or should have known that what he was doing was fraudulent,
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普本人也知道或应该知道他所做的事情是欺诈性的，

sentences.en: that the election was not stolen, and that people he had employed in the top ranks of the White
sentences.zh: 大选并没有被窃取，他在白宫高层雇佣的人曾多次告诉他这一点，但他仍然继续推卸责任，因为他想要保持权力。

sentences.en: House told him this repeatedly, and yet he continued to press the case because he wanted to stay in power.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 所以，举个例子，你会记得在佐治亚州，有人指控拜登的选票在半夜被偷运进来。

sentences.en: So, for example, you'll remember that in Georgia, there were accusations that ballots for Biden were being smuggled in in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普自己的司法部调查了这些说法，找不到任何证据证明它们是真的。

sentences.en: But Trump's own Justice Department looked into these claims and could find no evidence that they were true.
sentences.zh: 因此，时任副司法部长理查德·多纳休在

sentences.en: And so Richard Donahue, who was the deputy attorney general at the time, had this quote in the
sentences.zh: 委员会的闭门质询中留下了这样一段话，他说：我曾多次在数次对话中亲自告诉总统，关于选票被装在手提箱里偷运进来并通过机器的这些指控，

sentences.en: committee's deposition, and he said, I told the president myself several times in several conversations that these allegations about ballots being smuggled in in a suitcase and run
sentences.zh: 并非事实，我们已经查阅过了，我们看过录像，我们采访了证人，这不是真的。

sentences.en: through the machines, it was not true, that we had looked at it, we had looked at the video, we had interviewed the witnesses, and it was not true.
sentences.zh: 多纳休作证说，特朗普对他说：“我有什么好失去的？”

sentences.en: Donahue testified that Trump told him, what do I have to lose?
sentences.zh: “如果我这么做了，我有什么好失去的？”

sentences.en: If I do this, what do I have to lose?
sentences.zh: 多纳休回答说：“总统先生，你有很多东西要失去。”

sentences.en: And Donahue replied, Mr. President, you have a great deal to lose.
sentences.zh: “难道这真的是你想用来结束你政府任期的方式吗？”

sentences.en: Is this really how you want to end your administration?
sentences.zh: “你会伤害这个国家。”

sentences.en: You're going to hurt the country.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一个接近唐纳德·特朗普的人直接叫他住手，但特朗普依然一意孤行的例子。

sentences.en: So there's an example of somebody close to Donald Trump telling him directly to knock it off, and yet Trump continues.
sentences.zh: 委员会再次认为，这相当于欺诈。

sentences.en: Which the committee is, again, arguing amounts to fraud.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 所以我想这现在把我们带到了法官在本案中的裁决。

sentences.en: And so I think this brings us now to the judge's ruling in this case.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲那个吧。

sentences.en: So tell us about that.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 因此，法官做出了裁决，他压倒性地站在了1月6日委员会这一边。

sentences.en: So the judge issues his ruling, and he sides overwhelmingly with the January 6th committee.
sentences.zh: 因此法官做出了裁决，他压倒性地站在了1月6日调查委员会这一边。

sentences.en: He rules that Donald Trump and John Eastman likely committed both the obstruction of Congress count and the conspiracy to defraud the United States count.
sentences.zh: 他裁定唐纳德·特朗普和约翰·伊斯特曼可能触犯了妨碍国会罪以及串谋欺诈美国罪。

sentences.en: He says that their plan was a coup in search of a legal theory.
sentences.zh: 他说他们的计划是一场寻找法律理论支撑的政变。

sentences.en: And he says the illegality of their plan was obvious.
sentences.zh: 并且他说他们计划的违法性是显而易见的。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So very interestingly, this seemingly off-to-the-side lawsuit filed by John Eastman against the
sentences.zh: 很有意思的是，约翰·伊斯特曼针对

sentences.en: January 6th committee to prevent it from getting his documents, and the committee's response to the lawsuit ends up producing this very unexpectedly explosive ruling.
sentences.zh: 国会山骚乱调查委员会提起的一起看似微不足道的诉讼，旨在阻止委员会获取他的文件，而委员会对该诉讼的回应最终产生了这个非常出乎意料且具有爆炸性的裁决。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And this is a long-tenured judge who has heard a lot of cases in his time.
sentences.zh: 这是一位资深法官，他在任期间审理过大量案件。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And he is looking at the facts and the evidence and applying it to the law.
sentences.zh: 他正在审视事实和证据，并将其适用于法律。

sentences.en: And he says overwhelmingly, in his opinion, what happened on January 6th was a crime on behalf of Donald Trump and John Eastman.
sentences.zh: 他认为，在他的意见中，压倒性地表明，1月6日发生的事情是唐纳德·特朗普和约翰·伊斯特曼犯下的罪行。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 免费畅读？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请在今天下载《时报》应用并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Luke, what does it mean for this judge to have made this kind of ruling?
sentences.zh: 卢克，这位法官做出这样的裁决意味着什么？

sentences.en: So it's important to understand what this ruling is and what it isn't.
sentences.zh: 所以，理解这个裁决是什么以及它不是什么很重要。

sentences.en: This is a civil case and a civil ruling about getting documents from John Eastman.
sentences.zh: 这是一起民事案件，也是一项关于从约翰·伊斯特曼那里获取文件的民事裁决。

sentences.en: It's not a criminal prosecution.
sentences.zh: 这不是刑事起诉。

sentences.en: It does not mean Donald Trump will be put in handcuffs and marched out of Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着唐纳德·特朗普会被戴上手铐从海湖庄园带走。

sentences.en: It means that 101 of John Eastman's emails will have to be turned over to the committee, but they do not have an immediate criminal impact on either man.
sentences.zh: 这意味着约翰·伊斯特曼的101封电子邮件必须交给委员会，但它们对这两人没有直接的刑事影响话虽如此。

sentences.en: That said, this ruling is a major breakthrough for the committee, and here's why.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，这项裁决对委员会来说是一个重大突破，原因如下。

sentences.en: For months, the committee has been working tirelessly on this case, and their end goal is not just to write the authoritative report about what led to January 6th and
sentences.zh: 几个月来，委员会一直在不知疲倦地处理这个案件，他们的最终目标不仅是撰写一份权威报告，说明导致1月6日事件的原因，并

sentences.en: recommend changes to laws to try to prevent it from happening again.
sentences.zh: 建议修改法律以试图防止此类事件再次发生。

sentences.en: They are also compiling a case that they can turn over to the Justice Department and argue that this amounts to crimes on behalf of Donald Trump and his allies.
sentences.zh: 他们还在整理一份可以移交给司法部的案件材料，并辩称这构成了唐纳德·特朗普及其盟友的犯罪行为。

sentences.en: That's what's known as a criminal referral.
sentences.zh: 这就是所谓的刑事移交。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对的。

sentences.en: And this was the first test in court before a judge of the evidence they've compiled so far.
sentences.zh: 这是他们迄今为止整理的证据在法官面前接受的第一次法庭考验。

sentences.en: They put these explosive allegations into court saying the president of the United States had committed felonies, and they got exactly the ruling they wanted.
sentences.zh: 他们将这些爆炸性的指控提交法庭，称美国总统犯下了重罪，并且他们得到了完全想要的裁决。

sentences.en: And in fact, the judge's language was, in some cases, even stronger than the language that they had used in their filing.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在某些情况下，法官使用的措辞甚至比他们在文件中使用的措辞还要强烈。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You're saying that this was a successful road test of the kinds of charges that the
sentences.zh: 你是说，这是一次成功的实地测试，测试的对象是

sentences.en: January 6th committee may want the Justice Department to bring against Donald Trump and his allies.
sentences.zh: 国会山骚乱调查委员会可能希望司法部对唐纳德·特朗普及其盟友提出的指控类型。

sentences.en: And now the committee can say, look, a federal judge has said, we made a strong criminal case.
sentences.zh: 现在委员会可以说了，看吧，一位联邦法官已经表示，我们提出了强有力的刑事案件。

sentences.en: And so you, the Justice Department, you might get the same outcome if you decide to bring actual criminal charges against the former president and those around him.
sentences.zh: 所以你们司法部，如果你们决定对这位前总统及其周围的人提起真正的刑事指控，可能会得到同样的结果。

sentences.en: Yes, there are more than a dozen former federal prosecutors working on this case on behalf of
sentences.zh: 是的，有十几位前联邦检察官代表

sentences.en: the January 6th committee, and they took this as a major win that they are on the right track in compiling the case against Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 国会山骚乱调查委员会参与此案，他们认为这是一个重大胜利，表明他们在整理针对唐纳德·特朗普的案件方面走在了正确的道路上。

sentences.en: And it will only bolster their attempts to pursue a criminal referral against Donald Trump and his allies when the committee wraps up its work.
sentences.zh: 当委员会完成工作时，这只会增强他们寻求对唐纳德·特朗普及其盟友进行刑事移交的企图。

sentences.en: Okay, but let's make sure we introduce a lot of caveats here.
sentences.zh: 好的，但我们要确保在这里引入许多前置条件。

sentences.en: Because like you said, Luke, this was a ruling by a judge in a civil court.
sentences.zh: 因为就像你说的，卢克，这是法官在民事法庭做出的裁决。

sentences.en: And so is there a version of this where the ruling that you have just described to us
sentences.zh: 那么，是否存在这样一种情况，即你刚才向我们描述的裁决

sentences.en: shouldn't give the January 6th committee a whole lot of confidence?
sentences.zh: 不应该给国会山骚乱调查委员会带来太多的信心？

sentences.en: Yes, for a couple of reasons.
sentences.zh: 是的，原因有几个。

sentences.en: One, this is a civil case, not a criminal case.
sentences.zh: 第一，这是一起民事案件，而不是刑事案件。

sentences.en: In a criminal case, you have a much higher standard, which is beyond a reasonable doubt.
sentences.zh: 在刑事案件中，你的标准要高得多，即排除合理怀疑。

sentences.en: And in a civil case, this threshold is much, much lower.
sentences.zh: 而在民事案件中，这个门槛要低得多得多。

sentences.en: This was a preponderance of the evidence.
sentences.zh: 这是优势证据标准。

sentences.en: And so that's a big jump to go from what lawyers view as a 51% of the evidence threshold to a overwhelming standard, which is beyond a reasonable doubt.
sentences.zh: 因此，从律师认为的51%的证据门槛跨越到排除合理怀疑这一压倒性标准，是一个巨大的跨越。

sentences.en: The second consideration is the politics of this.
sentences.zh: 第二个考虑因素是政治因素。

sentences.en: We have no tradition in America of one administration coming in and trying to prosecute the previous administration.
sentences.zh: 在美国，我们没有一个政府上台后试图起诉上一届政府的传统。

sentences.en: We don't throw our past presidents in jail.
sentences.zh: 我们不会把过去的总统关进监狱。

sentences.en: We don't do that.
sentences.zh: 我们不这样做。

sentences.en: We have no history of it.
sentences.zh: 我们没有这样的历史。

sentences.en: And so for the Justice Department to pursue a former president would be unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 因此，司法部起诉前总统将是史无前例的。

sentences.en: And so that's a serious consideration for anyone at the Justice Department who is thinking about charging Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 对于司法部中任何考虑起诉唐纳德·特朗普的人来说，这是一个严肃的考虑因素。

sentences.en: Do we want to be the country where you prosecute the person who just held the White House before you?
sentences.zh: 我们是否想成为这样一个国家：你起诉刚刚卸任白宫职务的人？

sentences.en: So there's a lot of serious considerations for Merrick Garland and the Justice Department as they consider this case.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于梅里克·加兰和司法部在审理此案时，有许多严肃的考虑因素。

sentences.en: Well, to that point, do we know how the Department of Justice, which is the ultimate decision maker here, whether to charge the president or charge Eastman or charge anybody else
sentences.zh: 嗯，说到这一点，我们是否知道司法部——它是这里的最终决策者，决定是否起诉总统或起诉伊斯特曼或起诉其他任何人

sentences.en: with a federal crime related to January 6th,
sentences.zh: 涉嫌与1月6日有关的联邦罪行——

sentences.en: Do we know how the Department of Justice sees this civil ruling and the conclusion that that judge came to?
sentences.zh: 我们是否知道司法部如何看待这项民事裁决以及这位法官得出的结论？

sentences.en: Well, we don't.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们不知道。

sentences.en: Attorney General Merrick Garland has been very tight-lipped.
sentences.zh: 司法部长梅里克·加兰一直对此缄口不言。

sentences.en: The Justice Department is doing its own investigation, and we know that they're proceeding on that.
sentences.zh: 司法部正在进行自己的调查，我们知道他们正在推进此事。

sentences.en: They've charged more than 770 of the rioters, and we do know they're exploring the possibility of working their way up the food chain
sentences.zh: 他们已经起诉了770多名暴徒，我们确实知道他们正在探索顺藤摸瓜的可能性

sentences.en: to perhaps even higher-ranking people who were part of the plan.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能追查到参与该计划的更高层人员。

sentences.en: But again, Garland hasn't been commenting about that investigation or what the January 6th committee has been looking into, so we don't know specifically how he views the ruling.
sentences.zh: 但话说回来，加兰没有对该调查或国会山骚乱调查委员会一直在调查的内容发表评论，所以我们不知道他具体如何看待该裁决。

sentences.en: That said, I've talked with several former federal prosecutors who said that this ruling has to be ringing alarm bells at the Department of Justice,
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，我曾与几位前联邦检察官交谈过，他们表示这项裁决必定会在司法部敲响警钟，

sentences.en: that when you have a federal judge who has looked at the evidence, presented by the January 6th committee, and written the ruling that he did,
sentences.zh: 当有一位联邦法官审阅了国会山骚乱调查委员会提交的证据，并写下了这样的裁决时，

sentences.en: you're headed down the path towards a strong case.
sentences.zh: 你们正在朝着一个强有力的案件方向前进。

sentences.en: So what these former federal prosecutors are telling you is that this ruling may, at the very least, increase the pressure on the Justice Department
sentences.zh: 所以这些前联邦检察官告诉你的意思是，这项裁决至少可能会增加司法部的压力

sentences.en: to bring a criminal case against the former president, which would be one of the most momentous decisions of our time.
sentences.zh: 对前总统提起刑事诉讼，这将是我们这个时代最重大的决定之一。

sentences.en: What we can say is that it gives the people who want to charge the former president more ammunition.
sentences.zh: 我们可以说的是，它为那些想要起诉前总统的人提供了更多的弹药。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the committee will take this evidence, these emails from John Eastman, and continue to build their case as they investigate January 6th.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，委员会将利用这些证据、来自约翰·伊斯特曼的这些电子邮件，在调查1月6日事件时继续建立他们的案件。

sentences.en: We've heard there's plans to bring in 100 more witnesses as they move towards holding public hearings and eventually then filing their final report
sentences.zh: 我们听说有计划在他们走向举行公开听证会并最终提交最终报告的过程中引入100名更多的证人

sentences.en: in which they will unveil all of the evidence they've accumulated over this last year.
sentences.zh: 在报告中，他们将公布过去一年中积累的所有证据。

sentences.en: And they believe that all of that will only build on top of the case that they've been constructing and that they successfully argued in front of the judge
sentences.zh: 他们相信，所有这一切只会建立在他们一直在构建并在法官面前成功辩论的案件之上

sentences.en: in the case of John Eastman.
sentences.zh: 以约翰·伊斯特曼案为例。

sentences.en: I have to say, I am very much struck
sentences.zh: 我必须说，我深感震惊

sentences.en: by the irony of the fact that if John Eastman had just complied with the January 6th committee's subpoenas,
sentences.zh: 的一个讽刺事实是，如果约翰·伊斯特曼早点配合国会山骚乱调查委员会的传唤，

sentences.en: this would never have happened, right?
sentences.zh: 这一切就永远不会发生，对吧？

sentences.en: In trying to block the committee's work, it seems based on this ruling, he may have actually just strengthened their hand.
sentences.zh: 根据这项裁决，在试图阻挠委员会的工作时，他实际上可能正好增强了他们的筹码。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: If he never invokes attorney-client privilege, there is never the opportunity this early in the process for the January 6th committee to test out their arguments about criminality.
sentences.zh: 如果他从未援引律师与客户之间的特权，国会山骚乱调查委员会就永远不会在诉讼程序的如此早期阶段有机会检验他们关于犯罪的论点。

sentences.en: And it gave them a rare chance to put all of this evidence into the court record and have a judge decide whether or not they were on the right path.
sentences.zh: 这给了他们一个难得的机会，将所有这些证据提交法庭记录，并让法官决定他们是否走在正确的道路上。

sentences.en: And they heard overwhelmingly that they are.
sentences.zh: 他们听到压倒性的反馈是，他们确实走对了。

sentences.en: Luke, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 卢克，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: On Sunday, the Times reported that Attorney General Merrick Garland is under growing pressure, especially from Democrats, to bring criminal charges against Donald Trump
sentences.zh: 周日，《时报》报道称，司法部长梅里克·加兰正面临越来越大的压力，特别是来自民主党的压力，要求对唐纳德·特朗普提起刑事指控

sentences.en: over his role in the events leading up to and on January 6th, and that President Biden himself has confided to his inner circle that he believes Trump should be prosecuted.
sentences.zh: 因为他在1月6日之前及当天的事件中发挥了作用，而且拜登总统本人曾向他的核心圈子吐露，他认为应该起诉特朗普。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, Russian forces began to retreat from the towns around Ukraine's capital, Kiev, suggesting that their original plan to seize the city has collapsed.
sentences.zh: 周末期间，俄罗斯军队开始从乌克兰首都基辅周边的城镇撤退，这表明他们夺取该市的原计划已经破产。

sentences.en: During the retreat,
sentences.zh: 在撤退期间，

sentences.en: Ukrainian officials discovered what they said was evidence that Russian troops had executed Ukrainian civilians, including in the town of Buccia, northwest of Kiev.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰官员发现了他们所说的俄军处决乌克兰平民的证据，包括在基辅西北部的布查镇。

sentences.en: Footage from Buccia, posted by Ukraine's defense ministry, and photographs from news agencies showed the dead bodies of men in civilian clothes,
sentences.zh: 乌克兰国防部发布的来自布查的镜头以及新闻机构的照片显示了身穿平民服装的男子的尸体，

sentences.en: some of whom had their hands tied behind their backs.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人的双手被反绑在身后。

sentences.en: You can't help but see these images as a punch to the gut.
sentences.zh: 看到这些画面，你情不自禁地会感到犹如遭受当胸一击。

sentences.en: On Sunday, world leaders, including U.S.
